name: Heron Neutron Medical Corp.
summary: Heron Neutron Medical Corp. develops, manufactures, and sells medical instruments. It offers accelerator-based boron neutron capture therapy solutions, including neutron source target system, accelerator system, target system, beam shaping assembly, treatment control system, treatment planning system, and patient positioning system; and ACSI cyclotron products. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Zhubei, Taiwan.
